title: Reduce Reuse Recycle - Rebello Enclave
summary: On 8th November 2026, RCMSEP member Rtn. Rashmita, in collaboration with Girija Welfare Association, organised a collection drive at Rebello Enclave to collect pre-loved clothes and groceries for redistribution among underprivileged communities.
description:
On 8th November 2026, RCMSEP member Rtn. Rashmita, in collaboration with Girija Welfare Association, organised a collection drive at Rebello Enclave to collect pre-loved clothes and groceries for redistribution among underprivileged communities.

The initiative promotes responsible reuse and recycling by ensuring that wearable clothes reach those in need, while unwearable garments are channelled for recycling. The collected groceries will be distributed to needy families.

The drive will provide essential clothing and grocery support to underprivileged families while promoting sustainability through the reuse and recycling of textiles. It will help reduce waste, conserve resources and extend the useful life of donated items, creating both social and environmental impact.
location: Rebello Enclave, Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra
